info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Healthcare Appointments Providers-v1-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointments Providers API enables users to access a comprehensive list of healthcare providers available for appointments. This API facilitates the retrieval of key information about providers, including specialties, availability, and contact details. Typical consumers include healthcare applications, patient management systems, and any services requiring access to appointment scheduling data. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance their applications to assist users in finding and booking healthcare appointments efficiently.

get.description: Fetch a list of all available providers for appointments. This endpoint allows users to get essential information regarding various providers, enabling them to make informed decisions when scheduling appointments.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving available appointment providers. This should include any required parameters in JSON format to filter or specify the appointment details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved a list of appointment providers.

ListHealthcareAppointmentsProvidersReque.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the appointments providers endpoint. It is expected to be a simple string value.
